name: Thetanuts v1 vault residual-asset share mispricing
summary: Thetanuts v1 cash-settled vaults minted deposit shares at a fixed rate while initWithdraw paid out pro rata of the vault's live balance, so a vault holding residual assets against almost no shares could be drained by depositing and immediately withdrawing. A searcher bot first did this to one vault; the attacker then repeated it against eleven sibling vaults.
notes: The anchor is an unaffiliated MEV searcher's round trip through the SOL put vault, 6.5 hours before the reported attacker hit eleven other vaults of the same Thetanuts deployer with the same deposit/initWithdraw pattern; both belong to one campaign on sibling vaults (rule 4).

Selection: every transaction in which an address deposited USDC, WETH or WBTC into one of the deployer's 56 vaults and withdrew more in the same transaction; two such round trips by the deployer in 2022 are affiliated, and later team sweeps to 0xb5d33324 are recoveries.
Loss is each vault's net outflow per transaction at DefiLlama prices; most of the searcher's take went to the block builder as a bribe.
